clock.what: market poll + pipeline loop (candles, book, trades, Kalshi quotes → features → arm inference)
watchdog — restart daemon if heartbeat stale >5 min
clock.detail: authority: RESTART the daemon process only. Logs only when it acts — a days-old log means days of health, not neglect

clock.what: audit → site manifest → treatments board → decision board (chained)
gated retraining of neural arms (candidate vs holdout MSE; keep or revert)
model introspection → analyst data (weights, trace, representativeness, oracle)
score window, update online learners + calibrators, append treatment ledger

agents.name: The Daemon
agents.authority: READ market + WRITE ledgers + paper-trade the pre-registered policies
agents.cannot: change any policy constant, promote a treatment, touch real money (production key quarantined)

agents.name: Watchdog
agents.authority: restart the daemon when the heartbeat is stale

agents.name: Auditor
agents.authority: recompute all published metrics from raw ledgers (dual implementation vs the daemon)
agents.cannot: alter ledgers; it only reads and re-derives

agents.name: Fable — The Analyst
agents.trigger: hourly, after introspection refresh; plus session work with the owner
agents.authority: READ everything + PROPOSE (analyst notes, treatment proposals, retirement proposals)
agents.cannot: promote a treatment, modify production policy, spend money — every live-money decision terminates with the human (PROGRAM.md §3)

agents.name: Publisher
agents.authority: copy site + results snapshots to gh-pages

agents.name: Builder agents
agents.trigger: session-based, launched by the owner's directives
agents.authority: PROPOSE + BUILD site/scripts changes, verified by screenshot + parity fixtures before commit
agents.cannot: run unattended or alter trading policy

agents.name: The Owner (human)
agents.authority: the only authority that can promote, retire, or change live policy
